title: ACEF v1.1 Evidence Gap Payload (overlay)
description: ACEF Core v1.1 overlay of evidence_gap. Inlines the v1.0 property set (kept backward-compatible) and adds conditional discriminator-keyed enforcement for the V5 'evidence_freshness_window' variant per brief §4.5. The discriminator is /payload/gap_subtype = 'freshness_window'. Records that do NOT set /payload/gap_subtype validate exactly as under v1.0. Records that set it to 'freshness_window' MUST satisfy the time-window field set: window_start, window_end, refresh_due_at, current_freshness_state. NOTE: The V2 'regression_definition' variant parents to risk_treatment (NOT evidence_gap) per brief §4.2; its branch enforcement is therefore not declared here — it belongs in a future v1.1/risk_treatment.schema.json overlay.

missing_record_type.description: The record type that is missing or incomplete.

reason_description.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of why the evidence is missing.

expected_completion_date.description: Expected date when the evidence will be available (ISO 8601). Null if unknown.

remediation_plan.description: Description of the plan to remediate the evidence gap.

remediation_owner.description: Person or team responsible for the remediation.

gap_severity.description: How critical this evidence gap is to overall compliance.

blocking_provisions.description: Regulatory provisions that are blocked or affected by this evidence gap.

alternative_evidence.description: Description of any alternative or partial evidence available.

alternative_evidence_ref.description: URN reference to alternative evidence record, if available.

hash_commitment.description: SHA-256 hash commitment of the confidential evidence.

nda_reference.description: Reference to the NDA covering this evidence.

third_party_name.description: Name of the third party blocking evidence collection.

third_party_contact_date.description: Date the third party was contacted about providing the evidence (ISO 8601).

not_applicable_justification.description: Justification for why the evidence is not applicable.

gap_subtype.description: v1.1 discriminator for evidence_gap variants per brief §4.5. Registered values: 'freshness_window' (V5 evidence_freshness_window — time-bound expression of when a piece of evidence stops being current).

window_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the start of the freshness window (V5 evidence_freshness_window variant).

window_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the end of the freshness window (V5 evidence_freshness_window variant).

refresh_due_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp by which evidence MUST be refreshed (V5 evidence_freshness_window variant).

current_freshness_state.description: Current freshness state for the evidence in this window (V5 evidence_freshness_window variant).

allOf.$comment: VAL-VARIANT-003 conditional enforcement for the V5 evidence_freshness_window variant. When /payload/gap_subtype is 'freshness_window', the four window-specific fields are required. When unset, no additional constraint is imposed.
